messages:
elaine: Quick sync — sketching a proposal for per-tenant retention profiles + BYOK/ecscrow export flow. TL;DR: allow Default/Extended/Legal-hold profiles, map them to storage tiers, add an exportable evidence bundle with signed manifests, and surface a retention cost preview in the Console. asking for launch criteria + who owns which piece.

sam: Looks good. Quick Q: what's expected QPS/latency impact for retention reads (exports, legal holds)? Need to scope infra and backup windows.

raj: Security note — some finance customers require append-only signed logs. We should design a signing sidecar that stamps entries with sequence + signature (stored separately). Also: KMS compatibility matrix (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, customer HSM) needed for BYOK.

marcus: Ops POV — retention tiers imply cold archive (S3 Glacier / GCS Archive) vs hot. We need per-tenant cost attribution and a preview estimator. Also how do legal-hold spikes (mass TTL freeze) affect retention capacity and egress?

liz: Legal asks — exportable evidence must include chain-of-custody metadata (who triggered hold, timestamps, release events). Also need an auditable release workflow and ACLs for evidence exports.

jen: CS: a handful of pilot customers (FinServ1, HealthCo2) asked for 7y retention + BYOK. They'll accept a paid pilot. We should surface pilot signup flow and SLAs in sales playbook.

sam: Implementation idea — avoid giant full exports by doing hourly snapshots + incremental deltas. Pseudocode we discussed:
```
snapshot = take_prefix_snapshot(tenant_id)
export_stream = stream_export(snapshot, incremental=True)
```
This keeps export memory and egress bounded.

elaine: Proposed minimal launch criteria (for hosted beta):
1) UI/API: per-tenant retention profiles + set TTLs
2) BYOK import + attest path (hosted KMS integration + customer key import)
3) Exportable evidence bundle with signed manifest and chain-of-custody fields
4) Billing attribution + Console preview for estimated retention cost
5) Mapping doc showing how features meet SOC2/ISO controls
We can stagger Dedicated/Private and longer TTLs after beta.

raj: Add: threat model for key escrow compromise + revocation/rotation playbook. Also list HSM requirements and supported KMS algorithms.

marcus: Timeline ask — can Eng deliver a hosted-only beta in ~10 weeks if we scope down to profiles + export + BYOK import (no dedicated/private yet)? If yes, we can schedule Dedicated/Private for Q2 follow-up.

elaine: Sounds like consensus. Next steps: Eng to estimate effort this week, Legal to draft export manifest spec, CS to pick pilot customers and write pricing stub. I'll spin up the spec doc.

ci-bot: Checkpoint created: retention/profiles/spec-v1 at https://redwood/internal/retention/spec-v1 (automated)

sam: I'll post rough effort estimates by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
